caption: The card in the first row, second column, originally featuring a white horse on a black background, has been replaced with a card displaying a white circle, a brush, and a tube of toothpaste on a white background. The card in the third row, second column, which originally featured a smiling white tooth on a black background, has been replaced with a card showing a rocking horse on a white background. The card in the fourth row, first column, which originally featured a black and white striped pattern on a black background, has been replaced with a card displaying a black backpack on a white background. The card in the fourth row, third column, which originally featured a white mushroom on a black background, has been replaced with a card displaying a pair of multicolored footprints on a white background.

The black bird that was on the tree stump on the left side of the image has moved to the lower right corner of the image, with its head lowered and facing the ground. The quantity of food on the tree stump in the upper left corner has decreased.

The black pants on the right have disappeared. The yellow shirt on the left has been replaced by a white short-sleeved T-shirt with "AESTHETE" printed on it. The plaid top on the left has been moved to the right side of the white T-shirt, and a new pair of shorts with a pattern identical to the plaid top has appeared in its original position.
The posture of the figure changes from a side profile with the right leg raised and the left leg bent, to standing on the left leg with the right leg raised, arms extended horizontally.

The three people in the image change from a formation where the person on the left stands with their right leg forward, left leg backward, and both arms extended to the left side, to a formation where the three people stand in a row, facing forward, with their left legs straight, right legs bent backward, and both arms extended horizontally.

The posture of the person in the image changes from a position where the left leg is raised, the right leg is extended forward, the body is slightly tilted to the right, and both arms are bent with the right hand pointing forward, to a posture where the body is leaning forward, the left leg is straight, the right leg is bent and lifted, the right hand is raised and bent, and the left hand is extended forward.

The white remote control next to the fan has disappeared. A new white cup with a patterned design has appeared in the center of the scene, positioned between the box containing masks on the right and the blue bottle on the left.

The brightness of the scene has increased. A squirrel has appeared on the left tree stump, with its head lowered and facing toward the front left of the image. The quantity of peanuts on the tree stumps has changed.
The rear rack of the yellow electric car on the left side of the image has appeared.

The ambient lighting has dimmed. The polar bear on the right side of the frame, which was previously sitting with its head lowered and mouth closed, is now standing up with its mouth open. The polar bear in the middle of the frame, which was previously lying down with its head resting on the snow, is now leaning forward with its head resting on the mother polar bear's leg.

The overall lighting of the scene becomes brighter. Three people form a vertical line, with the person in the middle standing and the person at the bottom sitting on the ground. They all raise their arms to shoulder height, with their hands open. The three people change to three people standing upright, each raising one arm high while bending their bodies to the left.
The mouse has moved from the right side of the wooden box's entrance to the left side. Its head is now facing upward, and its body is standing on its hind legs.

The scene has become brighter. The lighting has dimmed. The squirrel on the left side of the image has disappeared.The black bird in the distance on the right side of the image has appeared.A new black bird has appeared on the tree stump on the left side of the image, with its back to the camera and its head turned to the right.
The scene has become brighter. The toy train on the right side of the scene has been moved to the left, and its direction has changed from facing left to facing right.

The red and white toy bus with the number "84" on its side has been replaced by a white police car with blue and orange stripes. The number of yellow balls in the center of the gray ottoman has decreased from one to none, and a new blue circular identification mark with the number "59" has appeared in its place. The white truck with colorful patterns on its front has moved from the left side of the ottoman to the right side.
A camera with a lens attached has appeared to the left of the keyboard. The black keyboard in front of the computer has been replaced by a camera with a lens attached.

The person in the blue jacket, who was previously sitting on the ground with legs crossed and arms spread wide, is now standing to the right of the orange-jacketed person. The person in the light blue jacket, who was previously standing behind the person in the orange jacket, is now standing to the left of the orange-jacketed person. The person in the orange jacket, who was previously standing behind the person in the blue jacket, is now standing in the middle. The three people are now leaning their bodies to the right, with their right hands raised high and their left hands placed on their chests.
The ambient lighting has brightened.
The purple disinfectant bottle on the left side of the pink hair dryer has been replaced with a transparent disinfectant bottle.

The posture of the figure changes from bending over with the head tilted back, arms raised high, and the body leaning backward to a pose where the right leg is lifted forward, the left leg stands firmly on the ground, both arms are extended outward, and the head is slightly tilted.

The scene has darkened, and the ambient lighting has become darker. The white pickup truck in the distance on the left side of the frame is no longer visible. The silver car that was previously in the center of the screen has disappeared. The red car at the back right of the screen has moved to the right side of the screen. The black SUV parked on the right side of the screen has appeared. The blue car in the distance on the right side of the screen has disappeared.

The ambient lighting has brightened. The pink basin on the left side of the second level has disappeared. The rectangular white object on the right side of the second level has disappeared, and a rectangular bar of soap has appeared in its place. The pink basin on the third level has disappeared. The pink basin on the fourth level has changed from pink to blue.
The ambient lighting has brightened. The black mouse on the right side of the keyboard disappeared, and a camera with a lens appeared to its left.
The ambient lighting has brightened. The mouse that was previously standing on its hind legs with its head facing upward is now lying flat in the mouse hole, with only its head and back visible.

The posture of the person in a white outfit changes from facing the right side with the left leg forward and the right leg backward, to facing the right side with the right leg forward and the left leg backward.

The polar bear on the right side of the image, which was previously standing with its head turned to the left and looking at the camera, is now lying down with its head resting on the snow. The polar bear in the middle of the image has changed from lying on the snow with its head facing upward to having its head resting on the back of the polar bear on the left.

The three people in the middle of the formation, who were previously standing with their feet together and hands hanging naturally at their sides, now have their left leg extended forward, their right leg bent backward, their arms crossed across their chests, and their bodies facing forward. The person on the far left, who was previously facing forward, now turns to face the left side of the frame. The person on the far right, who was previously facing forward, now turns to face the right side of the frame.
The black and white checkered top on the left side of the clothes rack has swapped positions with the orange shirt on the far left.
A new train toy has appeared in front of the toy seat on the left. An orange cone has appeared on the floor in the middle of the scene.

The card in the first row, first column, which featured a white sun on a black background, has been replaced with a card displaying two black leaves on a white background. The card in the second row, third column, which featured a pair of black footprints on a white background accompanied by colorful dots, has been replaced with a card featuring a black rocking horse on a white background. The card in the third row, second column, which featured a pair of black and yellow footprints on a white background, has been replaced with a card featuring a black toothbrush and tube of toothpaste on a white background.

The monitor, which was previously off, is now on. The yellow and black water cup in the left corner of the desk has been replaced with a black water cup. The red and blue flag hanging on the wall above the table is no longer visible. The books under the pen holder have appeared. The mouse placed on the mat has moved to the right side of the keyboard. The number of data disks in the middle of the table has decreased by one. The gray laptop placed vertically on the stand on the right side of the table has disappeared.
